# All-Star Renovations

> All-Star Renovations is a bathroom remodeling contractor in Conway, Arkansas, serving Central Arkansas (Faulkner, Pulaski, Saline and Lonoke counties). Most bathroom remodels, tub-to-shower conversions and walk-in showers are installed in 1-2 days. Call (501) 504-3398 for a free estimate. Official website: https://allstarreno.com

## Quick answers
- What does All-Star Renovations do? Bathroom remodeling (primary), plus kitchen remodeling and handyman services.
- Where is it located? Conway, AR (11 Arnett Ln, Conway, AR 72032).
- What areas does it serve? About 50 miles around Conway: Conway, Greenbrier, Vilonia, Little Rock, North Little Rock, Maumelle, Sherwood, Benton, Bryant, Cabot and nearby towns.
- How fast is a bathroom remodel? Most are completed in 1-2 days.
- How much does a shower remodel cost? All-Star Shower Systems packages start at $5,000-$7,499 (Premier), $7,500-$9,999 (Signature) and $10,000-$12,500+ (Designer).
- Is financing available? Yes, through Acorn Finance, HFS Financial and RenoFi.
- What warranty is offered? Lifetime product warranty on All-Star Shower Systems materials and a 5-year workmanship warranty.
- How do I get a quote? Call (501) 504-3398 or visit https://allstarreno.com/estimate.

## Business facts
- Name: All-Star Renovations (also seen as "All-Star Renovate" and "allstarreno"). All-Star Shower Systems is its branded shower line, not a separate company.
- Founded 2014 by Thomas Pedersen; 500+ completed bathroom remodels.
- Fully insured, workers' comp covered.
- Hours (Central Time): Mon-Fri 7:30 AM-5:00 PM; Sat 7:00 AM-7:00 PM; Sun 9:00 AM-3:00 PM.
- Phone: (501) 504-3398. Email: info@allstarreno.com.
- Canonical domain: https://allstarreno.com (www redirects here).

 Financing Disclaimer
 All-Star Renovations is a residential home improvement contractor and is neither a lender, financial broker, nor a financial institution. Financing options, payment examples and loan terms shown on this website are provided for illustrative and informational purposes only.
 All loan applications, pre-qualifications, interest rates, APRs, repayment terms and final approvals are administered independently by third-party lenders (Acorn Finance, RenoFi and HFS Financial). All financing is subject to credit approval, creditworthiness, income verification and individual lender criteria. Terms, rates and approval are set by the lender and subject to change. No financing approval or specific interest rate is guaranteed, and pre-qualification does not guarantee approval.
 Actual monthly payments, APRs, fees and terms vary by lender and applicant credit profile. The lender details shown are as described by each lender; offers are the lenders , not All-Star Renovations .

 Frequently Asked Questions
 Everything you need to know about our renovation process, pricing, and financing options.
 How long does a typical bathroom remodel take? Most of our bathroom remodeling projects, including shower replacements and tub-to-shower conversions, are completed in just 1 to 2 days. We prioritize efficiency without compromising on quality craftsmanship.
 Do you offer financing options? Yes. Financing is available through Acorn Finance , HFS Financial and RenoFi . You can apply for pre-qualification through the lenders using the links on this page. Rates, terms and approval are set by the lenders.
 How much does a bathroom remodel cost? Pricing varies depending on the scope of the project, materials selected, and specific requirements like accessibility features. We offer free, no-obligation in-home consultations where we review your project and provide a quote.
 Are your materials mold and mildew resistant? We use durable, non-porous materials designed to resist mold and mildew, making your new bathroom easy to clean and maintain.
 Do you provide a warranty for your work? Yes. All-Star Shower Systems materials carry a lifetime product warranty, and our installation work is backed by a 5-year workmanship warranty. Every project is also covered by our 100% Customer Guarantee.
 What services does All-Star Renovations offer? We offer bathroom remodeling (including All-Star Shower Systems, tub-to-shower conversions, walk-in showers, walk-in tubs and aging-in-place bathrooms), kitchen remodeling and handyman services.
 Are you insured? Yes. All-Star Renovations is fully insured and workers’ comp covered, with certified pros. We have been serving Central Arkansas since 2014.
 Where do you work? We are based in Conway, AR and serve a 50-mile radius of Conway, including Faulkner, Pulaski, Saline and Lonoke counties.
 What are your business hours? Monday to Friday 7:30 AM to 5:00 PM, Saturday 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM and Sunday 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM.

 Frequently Asked Questions 
 Accessible Bathroom Voice-Search Answers
 Clear, candid answers regarding insurance, project speed, and aesthetic styling.
 Does Medicare cover walk-in tubs in Arkansas?
 expand_more 
 Original Medicare (Part A and B) typically categorizes walk-in tubs and barrier-free showers as personal comfort or convenience items rather than primary Durable Medical Equipment (DME), meaning direct out-of-pocket coverage is rare. However, Arkansas seniors frequently utilize Medicare Advantage (Part C) specialized wellness stipends, VA Specially Adapted Housing (SAH/SHA) grants for qualifying veterans, or dedicated fixed-rate home improvement financing through HFS and Acorn Finance.
 How quickly can an accessible roll-in shower be installed?
 expand_more 
 At All-Star Renovations, our specialized installation team completes most seamless zero-threshold roll-in conversions within 1 to 2 consecutive days. We arrive with precision pre-measured materials, tear out the high-walled tub on morning one, rebuild the water barrier and backing, and install the finished composite walls and safety bars on day two.
 Can grab bars be installed without looking like a hospital room?
 expand_more 
 Absolutely. We exclusively install architectural grade, ADA-compliant safety bars (rated to 500 lbs load capacity) that blend seamlessly with high-end designer fixtures. Choose from brushed bronze, matte black, and satin nickel with multi-function integrations such as combination towel bars, corner soap shelves, and vertical shampoo ledges.
 Is a zero-threshold curbless shower wheelchair-accessible?
 expand_more 
 Yes. Our roll-in showers are engineered with a smooth zero-degree transition from your exterior floor, eliminating any raised lip. They accommodate standard manual and electric wheelchairs, shower transfer chairs, and walkers with linear channel drainage that stops water from escaping into the dry room.

 Before: Traditional Bathtub
 warning 
 The standard 15" to 18" threshold creates a severe trip-and-fall liability. Porous grout traps bacteria, mold thrives behind caulked joints, and acrylic yellows over time.
 close 
 Dangerous High-Step Wall: High friction, awkward entry for seniors and anyone with mobility restrictions. 
 close 
 Mildew Magnet: Degraded porous grout requiring toxic bleaches and back-breaking scrubbing. 
 close 
 Hidden Water Intrusion: Cracked caulking secretly rotting floor joists and framing beneath. 
 close 
 Cramped Enclosure: Clunky shower curtains or moldy bypass glass doors closing off lighting. 
 Typical Life Expectancy: 8–12 years before recurrent leak damage and subfloor decay.

 Engineering Comparison 
 Why RCB (Rigid Core Board) Outperforms Ceramic Tile & Acrylic
 Not all wet-area materials are built the same. While big-box franchises install flimsy 1/8" plastic sheets that sound hollow, All-Star utilizes structural composite RCB stone.
 Performance Metric 
 All-Star RCB Composite
 Ceramic / Porcelain Tile 
 Franchise Acrylic Sheets 
 Grout Maintenance & Mold Risk 
 100% Grout-Free, Impervious to Mildew
 Requires re-grouting & deep bi-weekly bleach scrubs 
 Grout-free, but caulk seams prone to peeling 
 Surface Rigidity & Sound 
 Solid stone feel, silent, zero deflection
 Rock-solid, but brittle over settling foundations 
 Hollow sound, noticeable flex and squeak when stepped on 
 Thermal Touch 
 Warm-to-the-touch composite insulation
 Freezing cold stone during Arkansas winter mornings 
 Plastic feel, low insulation value 
 UV & Chemical Resistance 
 Non-porous ceramic topcoat, stain-proof
 Chemical resistant, but harsh cleaners erode grout 
 Yellows under sunlight; scratches easily from scouring 
 Warranty Protection 
 Lifetime product + 5-year workmanship warranty

 Varies by manufacturer

 Straight Answers 
 Frequently Asked Questions
 Everything Central Arkansas homeowners ask about converting bathtubs into walk-in showers.
 Can a tub-to-shower conversion genuinely be finished in just 1 to 2 days? 
 expand_more 
 Yes. Traditional tile installations take 2 to 3 weeks due to repetitive drywall patching, mortar curing, grout drying, and sealing cycles. Because All-Star custom cuts high-density Rigid Core Board (RCB) composite panels to your exact layout off-site, our crew completes surgical tear-out, rough-in plumbing inspection, waterproofing, panel adhesion, and heavy frameless glass mounting in 24 to 48 hours total.
 What happens if you find hidden rot or termite damage behind my old tub? 
 expand_more 
 Unlike franchise installers who only glue acrylic over preexisting rot, Thomas Pedersen is the founder of All-Star Renovations. We review the condition of the space during your in-home quote, and if subfloor damage or outdated plumbing is discovered, we discuss the options with you before work continues.
 Will converting my tub to a shower hurt the resale value of my home? 
 expand_more 
 As long as your residence retains at least one conventional tub in a guest or secondary bath for small children, replacing the primary or master bathtub with a luxury walk-in shower substantially increases buyer interest and appraisal value in the Conway and Little Rock real estate markets. Modern walk-in showers are consistently ranked among the highest-return bathroom renovation features.
 Do you offer zero-barrier curbless entry for wheelchairs and walkers? 
 expand_more 
 Absolutely. We specialize in both ultra-low 2-inch thresholds and true zero-threshold curbless roll-in entries compliant with ADA recommendations. We can integrate in-wall solid wood backing for heavy-duty grab bars (supporting up to 500 lbs), comfortable fold-down teak benches, and thermostatic anti-scald mixing valves.

## Aging-in-Place & ADA Bathroom Design Guide | All-Star
URL: https://allstarreno.com/blog/aging-in-place-bathroom-design
Aging-in-place and ADA bathroom design guide: curbless zero-threshold showers, grab bars, seating and safety planning for Central Arkansas homes.

auto_awesome 
 Key Architectural Takeaway 
 Quick Summary 
 Aging-in-place bathroom remodeling focuses on zero-barrier curbless showers, ADA-compliant commercial wall-stud blocking for grab bars, textured slip-resistant floors, and thermostatic anti-scald valves. Done correctly by All-Star Renovations, these safety features blend seamlessly into a modern luxury aesthetic using warm brass fixtures and designer composite marble panels—completely eliminating clinical, hospital-like appearances while protecting homeowner autonomy.
 According to the National Institute on Aging, many serious falls in the home happen in the bathroom. Stepping over a 15-inch standard tub ledge, slick glazed porcelain tiles, and inadequate towel bars that snap under body weight create high-risk environments for retirees across Conway, Little Rock, and Faulker County.
 Yet, the traditional solution—stainless steel institutional pipes and hospital-grade plastic fixtures—often deters homeowners from taking timely preventive action. Our mission at All-Star Renovations is to prove that safety and architectural elegance are not mutually exclusive. By pairing universal design principles with luxury brass hardware, Italian-inspired marble patterns, and rich natural teak woods, your bathroom can be the safest sanctuary in your home without sacrificing an ounce of pride or resale appraisal.
 Universal Design Framework 
 The 7 Core Pillars of Senior Bathroom Safety
 Each engineering element is specified to eliminate trip hazards, stabilize balance transfers, and maintain continuous personal dignity.
 1 
 Curbless Zero-Entry Thresholds
 Zero Trip Obstacle • Roll-In ADA Compliant 
 Standard shower pans feature a 4 to 6-inch lip, and traditional cast iron bathtubs stand up to 18 inches high. Stepping sideways while lifting your foot over an obstacle while wet is the leading trigger for lateral hip fractures.
 Our installers recess and slope the bathroom subfloor precisely 1/4 inch per foot toward an invisible, high-capacity linear trench drain . The result is a flush, continuous transition that easily welcomes walkers, transfer wheelchairs, or barefoot family members without a single raised barrier.
 check_circle 
 Recessed Subfloor Slopes: Preserves level bathroom floorlines without leaks. 
 check_circle 
 Linear Slotted Drains: Handles up to 12 gallons/min to stop water overflow. 
 2 
 250lb+ Load-Rated Designer Grab Bars
 Architectural Finishes • Reinforced Solid Stud Backing 
 Most towel bars are secured with simple plastic drywall anchors rated for under 20 lbs. When a slip begins, natural reflex causes a person to yank the nearest fixture—often ripping the towel bar from the wall and aggravating injury.
 We anchor structural 2x6 framing lumber inside the wall framing before installing solid surfaces. We then mount heavy-gauge stainless steel bars styled with champagne bronze, brushed nickel, or matte black finishes. These double as stylish shampoo shelves or luxury towel holders while exceeding 500-lb ADA pull tests.
 verified 
 500 lb Structural Pull
 Framed directly to wood studs
 style 
 Dual-Purpose Styling
 Disguised as towel rails & ledges
 palette 
 Brushed Warm Bronze
 Zero hospital-chrome feel
 3 
 Non-Slip Textured Floor Systems (R10+ Rating)
 Tactile Traction Even Under Soapy Film 
 Standard glossy bathroom tiles become near-frictionless ice rinks when shampoo, conditioner, and body wash lather contact the surface.
 All-Star Renovations specifies textured natural river pebble mats embedded in epoxy matrix, or molded composite textured bases achieving dynamic coefficient of friction (DCOF) scores well above 0.60 wet. You gain reliable, comforting tactile feedback underfoot without rough abrasive textures that irritate sensitive skin.
 4 
 Fold-Down Teak Wood Shower Benches
 Spa-Inspired Warmth • 400lb Dynamic Load 
 Loose plastic medical shower chairs wobble, trap bacteria in suction cups, and make homeowners feel like patients in their own residence.
 Instead, we wall-mount contoured solid Burmese Teak seats on stainless steel hinges rated for 400 pounds. Teak’s dense natural oils provide lifelong resistance to mold and rot. When folded up against the wall, it requires a mere 3 inches of clearance—maximizing showering space for standing family members.
 5 
 Thermostatic Anti-Scald Mixing Valves
 Instant Automatic Temperature Protection 
 Senior skin thins over time, making it significantly more vulnerable to thermal burns in seconds. Furthermore, when a sudden blast of scalding water hits someone due to a running washing machine, the instinctive jerk backward almost inevitably sparks a dangerous slip.
 We install thermostatic pressure-balancing safety cartridges that mechanically lock water temperatures below 120°F. If cold water pressure drops unexpectedly, the valve shuts down flow within a fraction of a second.
 6 
 Dual Slide Handheld Shower Wands
 Featuring lightweight 72-inch non-kink stainless steel hoses. Allows effortless full-body rinsing while resting comfortably on the fold-down teak bench, as well as easy wall and pet washdowns.
 7 
 36-Inch Wide Clear Doorways
 Standard 28-inch bathroom doors cannot accommodate standard rollators or transport wheelchairs. We re-frame entries or install offset expandable swing-clear hinges for smooth zero-snag transit.
 Financial Relief Matrix 
 Arkansas Financial Assistance, Grants & Tax Deductions
 Navigating funding channels can save thousands on home safety remodels across Arkansas.
 military_tech 
 VA HISA Grants 
 Programs vary 
 The Veterans Affairs Home Improvements and Structural Alterations (HISA) grant provides disabled veterans and servicemembers funding for curbless entryways and roll-in showers.
 Applicability: Eligibility and grant amounts vary; check current program rules with the VA.
 local_hospital 
 ARChoices Waiver 
 Arkansas DHS Assisted 
 The Arkansas Department of Human Services Medicaid waiver program helps qualifying seniors age 65+ avoid nursing home admission with accessibility home modifications.
 Applicability: Income-eligible Arkansas seniors requiring physical assistance.
 receipt_long 
 IRS Medical Deductions 
 IRS Publication 502 
 If safety retrofits are prescribed by a physician to alleviate physical disability, costs (less any home value increase) can be deductible as medical expenses on Schedule A.
 Applicability: Grab bars, doorway expansions, wheelchair showers.
 info 
 Contractor Note: All-Star Renovations can provide itemized construction estimates that case managers and accountants may request when you pursue grant or funding approval.
 Expert Insights 
 Frequently Asked Questions: Senior Bathroom Upgrades
 Direct answers from our Conway-based remodeling team.
 How much does a curbless ADA roll-in shower cost in Central Arkansas? 
 expand_more 
 The cost of a curbless roll-in shower depends on structural subfloor re-sloping, linear trench drain installation, grab bar blocking and wall surround selections, and a full aging-in-place bathroom adds items such as widened doors and comfort-height fixtures. We provide a written quote after a free in-home visit so you can see what is included.
 Can grab bars be added to existing shower walls without tearing them down? 
 expand_more 
 While specialized hollow-wall wing anchors exist, All-Star Renovations strongly advises installing structural 2x6 or 2x8 solid wood backing directly into wall studs. When converting or renovating showers, our craftsmen frame dedicated internal wood blocking capable of exceeding ADA 500-pound pull benchmarks, preventing disastrous substrate failures and fractured fiberglass.
 Does Medicare or Arkansas Medicaid cover bathroom safety remodels? 
 expand_more 
 Traditional Medicare Part A and B rarely cover physical bathroom modifications, classifying them as home improvements rather than durable medical equipment (DME). However, Arkansas Medicaid ARChoices in Homecare waivers, VA HISA (Home Improvements and Structural Alterations) grants and medical tax deductions under IRS Publication 502 may provide financial relief; check eligibility with the program or a tax professional.
 How quickly can an emergency safety conversion be installed for someone returning from rehab or hospital? 
 expand_more 
 Through our expedited Priority Discharge Care track, All-Star Renovations completes turnkey barrier-free shower conversions in just 1 to 2 days once custom acrylic or composite wall systems are fabricated, ensuring your loved one transitions safely into an accessible home directly from hospital or physical therapy rehabilitation.

## What Affects the Cost of a Bathroom Remodel | All-Star Renovations
URL: https://allstarreno.com/blog/bathroom-remodeling-cost-guide
The main factors that shape a bathroom remodeling quote in Central Arkansas, and the questions to ask when you compare proposals. Free in-home quote: (501) 504-3398.

Planning Guide What Affects the Cost of a Bathroom Remodel 
 Every bathroom is different. Here are the factors that shape a remodeling quote, and the questions to ask when you compare proposals.
 Get Your Free Quote (501) 504-3398 
 Cost Factors What Shapes a Bathroom Remodeling Quote
 Exact figures depend on your bathroom, so we quote in person after seeing the space.
 Scope of work
 A shower replacement, a tub-to-shower conversion and a full remodel are different projects. The more that changes, the more the project involves.
 Layout and plumbing
 Moving a drain, valve or fixture adds work behind the wall. Keeping fixtures where they are keeps things simpler.
 Wall and surface materials
 Tile, acrylic and grout-free panel systems differ in installation time, maintenance and look.
 Glass, hardware and fixtures
 Enclosures, valves, shower heads and trim vary widely in style and specification.
 Accessibility features
 Zero-threshold entries, grab bar blocking, benches and handheld sprayers shape the design.
 What is behind the wall
 Older bathrooms can hide moisture damage or outdated plumbing. An in-person inspection is the only way to know.
 Size of the space
 A larger bathroom generally means more surface area and more installation time.
 Schedule
 Tell us when you need the bathroom back so the plan fits your timeline.
 Compare Quotes Questions to Ask Every Contractor
 What is included in the written scope, and what is not? 
 Who does the work: the company s own crew or subcontractors? 
 How will the walls and floor be checked for moisture damage? 
 What warranty applies to the materials and to the installation? 
 What happens if something unexpected is found behind the wall? 
 How and when will the work area be cleaned up?

The complete tub-to-shower conversion guide for Central Arkansas: 1–2 day grout-free installs, process, options and what to expect.

Local Project Case Study 
 From Cramped 1980s Fiberglass to Spa-Grade Walk-In
 Documented 36-hour transformation completed in Conway, Arkansas. Notice the shift from a high 15-inch hazardous acrylic ledge to a flush-entry, frameless tempered glass retreat.
 Before: 1994 Alcove Tub
 After: 48-Hour Conversion
 code 
 touch_app 
 Drag slider horizontally to inspect fixture alignment, wall waterproofing, and low threshold 
 Location: Conway, AR (Meadowlake Area)
 Duration: 1.5 Days
 The 48-Hour Installation Process
 Our certified crew executes an uncompromised military-precision sequence designed to protect your home's structure while ensuring flawless water-containment.
 DAY 1 • 08:00 – 12:00 
 01 
 Surgical Tear-Out & Plumbing
 We remove old cast iron or fiberglass tubs without disturbing adjoining drywall. Copper/PEX water lines are re-routed and copper drain traps are aligned to laser level.
 check_circle Subfloor rot inspection complete
 DAY 1 • 13:00 – 17:00 
 02 
 Sub-Pan Anchor & Moisture Seal
 Reinforced structural sub-base is bedded into commercial mortar. We install slip-resistant, non-porous composite pans with pre-pitched 1/4" drainage grades.
 check_circle 100% leak-proof hydrostatic check
 DAY 2 • 08:00 – 12:30 
 03 
 Direct-to-Stud RCB Wall Panels
 Solid stone-composite slabs are laser-cut and anchored directly to the framing. Tongue-and-groove mechanical joints lock flush with zero exposed grout lines.
 check_circle Antimicrobial nano-coating
 DAY 2 • 13:00 – 16:30 
 04 
 Tempered Glass & Final Cure
 Installation of 3/8" heavy architectural glass enclosures, Moen/Delta valve fixtures, grab bars, and marine-grade silicone. Ready for use the following morning.
 check_circle Arkansas inspector sign-off

 Homeowner Knowledge Base 
 Frequently Asked Questions About Tub Conversions
 Clear, honest facts from the All-Star Renovations team.
 Can any standard bathtub be converted into a walk-in shower? 
 expand_more 
 Yes. Almost all standard alcove tubs measure 60 inches long by 30 or 32 inches wide. Our system fits directly into this exact footprint. We remove the tub down to the framework, adjust plumbing traps, and drop in a custom-engineered non-porous composite pan that matches your current floor height.
 How long does a tub-to-shower conversion take from start to finish? 
 expand_more 
 Standard conversions are completed in 1 to 2 business days (24 to 48 hours) . On Day 1, tear-out, plumbing rough-ins, and pan leveling occur. On Day 2, our technicians mount the RCB composite walls, install safety grab bars, and hang heavy 3/8" tempered glass. Your shower is ready for full use the next morning following silicone cure.
 Will water splash out of a low-barrier walk-in shower? 
 expand_more 
 Not when properly designed. Our shower pans incorporate an internal 1/4-inch slope directed straight to the central drain. Additionally, our custom frameless glass enclosures and bottom sweep deflector seals stop splashes completely while preserving an open, airy feeling.
 Is a tub-to-shower conversion covered by a warranty? 
 expand_more 
 Yes. All-Star Renovations provides a Lifetime product + 5-year workmanship warranty against cracking, chipping, water infiltration, and mold discoloration. Our installations are fully insured and backed by local craftsmen based in Conway.
 Fast-Track Your Renovation

 Plan Ahead Planning Notes for Benton Kitchens
 These are general planning points to prepare before your visit. Scope is confirmed in person.
 Work sequence. Cabinets, countertops and backsplash depend on each other. Ask for the order of work in writing. 
 Backsplash and outlets. Note where outlets and switches sit; they affect backsplash layout.

 Sink and plumbing location. If the sink or dishwasher moves, plumbing changes affect scope and scheduling. Say so early. 
 Flooring transitions. Tell us whether flooring will change so cabinet heights and toe-kicks are planned together.

URL: https://allstarreno.com/privacy-policy
How All-Star Renovations collects, uses and protects your information when you request a quote or contact us.

 Privacy Policy
 We respect your home and your privacy. All-Star Renovations will never sell, rent, license, or trade your personal information to third-party telemarketers, lead aggregators, or robo-callers.

 gavel 
 Arkansas Commercial & Residential 
 fingerprint 
 Section 01
 1. Information We Collect
 All-Star Renovations collects only the pertinent residential data necessary to calculate precise remodeling estimates, conduct in-home laser measurement consultations, schedule wet-area installations, and provide post-installation lifetime material guarantees throughout Central Arkansas.
 badge 
 Contact & Identity Identifiers
 Full legal name, primary telephone number, email address, and home physical service address where wet-space conversions, ADA walk-in showers, or kitchen transformations are scheduled.
 home_work 
 Home & Structural Specifications
 Bathroom dimensions, subfloor status (slab vs. crawlspace), plumbing drain alignments, photographs submitted for remote pre-assessments, age of structure, and accessibility accommodation requests (e.g., zero-threshold entries, grab bar reinforcements, seating).
 chat_bubble_outline 
 Interactive Digital Dialogues
 Transcripts and selections gathered through our interactive embedded Swivl quoting assistant, direct telephone consultations, appointment scheduler inputs, and inbound text communications.
 task_alt 
 Section 02
 2. How We Use Your Information
 We limit the processing of your information strictly to operational construction deliverables, project logistics, and explicit customer requests:
 check_circle 
 Delivering Architectural Estimates: Calculating custom dimensional quotes for tub-to-shower conversions, barrier-free walk-ins, and full interior renovations. 
 check_circle 
 Fulfilling 1–2 Day Rapid Installations: Coordinating in-house craftsmen, staging plumbing materials, securing city permits in Conway or Faulkner County, and executing zero-delay site work. 
 check_circle 
 Facilitating Flexible Financing: Transmitting your application strictly with authorized, bank-grade lending networks ( HFS Financial and Acorn Finance ) solely upon your direct direction and request. 
 check_circle 
 Warranty & Service Records: Maintaining structural lifetime warranties and serial records for acrylic, composite wall panels, and Moen/Kohler fixtures installed in your home. 
 smart_toy 
 Section 03
 3. Swivl Lead & Quoting Technology
 Our digital platform utilizes Swivl web applications ( embed.swivl.tech ) to provide homeowners with real-time preliminary quote calculations, automatic schedule sync, and 24/7 intelligent remodeling support.
 encrypted 
 Isolated Swivl Transmission Environment
 Interactions through the Swivl Instant Quote Calculator and Chat Concierge travel over encrypted SSL endpoints directly into All-Star Renovations' internal dispatch queue. Swivl acts strictly as our contracted data processor under confidentiality agreements and does not retain ownership of your project records, nor do they sell homeowner submissions to competing contractor portals.
 verified 
 Section 04 • Ironclad Pledge
 4. Information Sharing & The Zero-Spam Guarantee
 We Never Sell Your Details. Period.
 When you submit a quote request with All-Star Renovations, you speak with All-Star Renovations. Your phone number, email, and address are never auctioned, bundled, or shared with third-party contractor networks (such as Angi, HomeAdvisor, Thumbtack), lead-generation brokers, or unaffiliated telemarketing call centers.
 Legitimate Third-Party Collaborations Occur Only When:
 local_shipping 
 Material Manufacturers
 Registering manufacturer lifetime serial warranties directly to your residence. 
 account_balance 
 Authorized Lenders
 Only if you elect to apply for home improvement terms with HFS or Acorn Finance. 
 location_city 
 Municipal Code Inspections
 Pulling official plumbing or electrical remodeling permits required by Arkansas code. 
 shield 
 Legal Compliance
 Complying with valid legal process, subpoena, or Arkansas state regulatory mandate. 
 cookie 
 Section 05
 5. Cookies, Web Analytics & AI Crawlers
 Our website uses minimal, functional tracking technologies designed exclusively to ensure snappy page rendering, retain estimate calculator selections, and gather anonymized website usage metrics.
 Essential Session Cookies: Maintain your progress through multi-step quote questionnaires and retain interface accessibility settings.
 Anonymized Site Analytics: We evaluate aggregate metrics (such as page speed, bounce rate, and high-interest remodeling articles) without storing individual consumer identities.
 Public Search Engine & AI Indexing: We publish clear, structured content schemas so conversational AI assistants (e.g., Perplexity, Google SGE, Siri) can present accurate Central Arkansas licensing credentials, operating hours, and standard shower conversion timelines to homeowners searching via voice or text.
 enhanced_encryption 
 Section 06
 6. Data Security & Storage Protocols
 All-Star Renovations employs multi-layered architectural safeguards to protect your personal home documents, project photos, and contact history against unauthorized disclosure, loss, or manipulation:
 lock_clock 
 256-Bit SSL Encryption 
 All web transmissions and quote requests are encrypted in transit. 
 admin_panel_settings 
 Role-Restricted Access 
 Only authorized Arkansas project managers view customer addresses. 
 cloud_sync 
 Secure Cloud Archive 
 Stored in SOC2-compliant databases with routine security reviews. 
 ring_volume 
 Section 07
 7. SMS & Phone Communication Disclosure (A2P 10DLC)
 By supplying your phone number through an instant quote form, consultation scheduler, or text conversation, you agree that All-Star Renovations may contact you via voice call or SMS text message to coordinate your project.
 Standard SMS Guidelines & Opt-Out Provisions:
 Message Purpose: Consultation schedule confirmation, estimator ETA notifications, digital design proofs, and critical installation logistics.
 Frequency: Typically 2–4 text messages per booked project phase. We do not blast recurring automated marketing texts.
 Message & Data Rates: Standard mobile carrier rates may apply depending on your provider plan.
 Opt-Out Command: You may reply STOP to any SMS at any time to immediately cancel all future text messages. Reply HELP for immediate staff assistance.
 manage_accounts 
 Section 08
 8. Homeowner Rights & Opt-Out Requests
 Regardless of whether your project is active, completed, or in preliminary estimation, you retain full sovereignty over your consumer records:
 Right to Inspect 
 Request a digital summary copy of all measurements, architectural notes, and billing history attached to your property.
 Right to Erasure 
 Request deletion of uncontracted lead profiles or outdated contact records (subject only to state tax and warranty retention laws).
 Right to Correction 
 Update or rectify inaccurate primary phone numbers, emails, or changed address coordinates anytime.
 No Retaliatory Bias 
 We will never alter remodeling pricing, warranty terms, or service commitments because you exercise your privacy rights.
 location_on

 FAQ Benton Remodeling FAQs

 What services can I get? Bathroom remodeling is our primary service, including All-Star Shower Systems, tub-to-shower conversions, walk-in showers, walk-in tubs and aging-in-place bathrooms. We also do kitchen remodeling and handyman services.

 policy 
 Contractual Preamble & Standard of Craft 
 Welcome to All-Star Renovations (“All-Star Renovations,” “Company,” “we,” “us,” or “our”). These Terms and Conditions govern your engagement with our website ( allstarreno.com ), our Swivl instant calculation and appointment booking platforms, and all subsequent in-home remodeling agreements entered into with property owners throughout Conway, Faulkner County, Pulaski County, and the broader Central Arkansas territory.
 By accessing our digital interfaces, submitting quote parameters, scheduling an in-home assessment, or signing a formal Work Authorization Agreement, you acknowledge and agree to be bound by the specific legal and mechanical provisions outlined herein.
 1 
 Acceptance of Terms & Scope of Services
 Section 1.0 
 1.1 Binding Agreement: By accessing our digital domains or executing a residential remodeling proposal, you affirm that you are of legal contracting age (at least 18 years old) and hold lawful ownership title or verified authorized tenancy of the Arkansas residential property specified for renovation.
 1.2 Scope of Operations: All-Star Renovations specializes exclusively in residential wet-area transformations, tub-to-shower conversions, zero-barrier ADA-compliant roll-in enclosures, walk-in safety bathtubs, and comprehensive architectural kitchen and bath surface upgrades.
 1.3 Integration of Digital Quoting Tools: Third-party automated estimation widgets deployed via Swivl Technologies Inc. serve exclusively to provide initial informational ranges based on client-provided parameters. Interaction with these digital interfaces does not establish an unconditional contract to perform construction until a signed, formal contract is executed by both the homeowner and an authorized All-Star Renovations officer following on-site verification.
 2 
 Estimates, Pricing Packages & 30-Day Bid Validity
 Section 2.0 
 2.1 Non-Binding Automated Quotes: Instant calculations generated via the Swivl online tool reflect estimated preliminary brackets based entirely upon self-selected user inputs (e.g., existing alcove tub removal, standard wall panelling, basic chrome trim). These automated calculations are strictly exploratory and non-binding.
 2.2 Mandatory In-Home Inspection: A binding written contract requires an on-site mechanical evaluation, digital laser measurement of wall plumbness, structural assessment of the underlying subfloor framing, and inspection of domestic copper/PEX supply lines and PVC drain venting.
 Established Central Arkansas Wet-Area Packages 
 Premier Conversion 
 $5,000 – $7,499 
 Standard acrylic or composite wall surrounds, standard base, Moen chrome fixture package, 1–2 day installation. 
 Signature Walk-In 
 Most Popular 
 $7,500 – $9,999 
 Rigid Core Board (RCB) stone patterns, semi-frameless glass door, comfort corner bench, built-in recessed niche. 
 Designer / ADA Safety 
 $10,000 – $12,500+ 
 Zero-threshold roll-in entry, commercial grade grab safety bars, ADA fold-down teak seating, thermostatic valves. 
 2.3 30-Day Fixed Price Guarantee: Once our Licensed Contractor conducts the in-home measurement, the resulting written proposal remains guaranteed and immune to raw material fluctuations for exactly thirty (30) calendar days from the date of issuance.
 3 
 Installation Timelines & 1–2 Day Wet-Area Protocol
 Section 3.0 
 3.1 Standard 1–2 Day Execution: Most alcove tub-to-shower conversions, single-wall enclosure updates, and Rigid Core Board (RCB) installations are scheduled to be completed within one to two (1–2) consecutive working business days following demolition commencement.
 3.2 Exclusions & Unforeseen Conditions: The 1–2 day timeline assumes sound structural framing, uncorrupted subflooring, and code-compliant rough-in plumbing behind the existing wet wall. Timelines may be extended under the following documented events:
 check_circle 
 Discovery of dry rot, termite damage, or structural sagging requiring structural sistering or joist rebuilds. 
 check_circle 
 Active biological contamination, black mold (Stachybotrys chartarum), or extensive plumbing leaks mandating drying time. 
 check_circle 
 Special-order non-stock designer fixtures, bespoke custom glass fabrication delays, or municipal Faulkner County permit holds. 
 3.3 Jobsite Access: Homeowner agrees to furnish unhindered physical access to the premises, clear pathways from the exterior entryway, electrical power, water shut-off access, and climate control between 7:30 AM and 5:00 PM CST during all working days.
 4 
 Lifetime product warranty & Workmanship Coverage
 Section 4.0 
 4.1 Rigid Core Board (RCB) Lifetime product warranty: All-Star Renovations guarantees that all engineered composite wet-area wall panels installed by our technicians will remain free from manufacturing delamination, bubbling, peeling, discoloration, water infiltration through panel bodies, and structural fracturing for the lifetime of the original property owner.
 4.2 Zero-Grout Cracking Guarantee: Because our solid composite wall systems utilize engineered interlocking joints and sanitary polymer sealant rather than traditional porous cementitious grout, All-Star Renovations guarantees against grout decay, grout mildew migration, and wall grout cracking.
 shield 
 100% Customer Guarantee Period 
 In addition to the lifetime material warranty from the panel manufacturer, All-Star Renovations provides a comprehensive five (5) year direct labor workmanship warranty covering plumbing connections, silicone seals, shower pans, drain attachments, and grab bar anchors installed by our crew.
 4.3 Warranty Limitations & Exclusions: This warranty does not cover damage resulting from: (a) homeowner structural settling or foundation movement; (b) use of abrasive cleaners, bleach-based scouring powders, or steel wool pads; (c) unapproved customer modifications, drillings, or repairs by third-party unlicensed technicians; or (d) catastrophic weather events, residential flooding, or freezing pipe ruptures.
 5 
 Third-Party Consumer Financing Disclaimers
 Section 5.0 
 5.1 Independent Lending Partners: All-Star Renovations is a licensed general remodeling contractor and is not a direct financial institution, bank, or loan underwriter. We partner with federally compliant third-party consumer lending facilitators, specifically HFS Financial and Acorn Finance , to provide convenient payment solutions for our clients.
 5.2 Discretion of Underwriters: All loan decisions, underwriting criteria, credit approvals, interest rates (APRs), promotional 0% interest periods, repayment durations, and origination charges are determined exclusively by the respective third-party lending partners based on individual consumer credit scores.
 5.3 Separation of Obligations: The execution of a financing agreement with HFS Financial or Acorn Finance creates a direct legal and financial contract solely between the borrower and the lender. Failure to secure financing does not relieve the homeowner of obligations under an executed Work Authorization Agreement unless specified via an explicit financing contingency addendum.
 6 
 Change Orders & Concealed Structural Conditions
 Section 6.0 
 6.1 Subsurface Concealment: While our initial in-home inspection leverages acoustic and electronic moisture detection, existing porcelain bathtubs, tiled alcoves, and fiberglass enclosures inherently mask the interior structural stud bays and subflooring underneath.
 6.2 Mandatory Written Change Order Procedure: If demolition reveals concealed dry rot, compromised wood joists, lead waste lines, galvanized iron pipe corrosion, or non-code venting:
 A 
 Work in the affected subfloor or framing zone will pause immediately. 
 B 
 High-resolution photographic evidence and physical inspection are provided directly to the homeowner. 
 C 
 A formal written Change Order outlining exact supplemental materials, carpenter labor rates, and timeline impacts must be countersigned before corrective restoration begins. 
 All-Star Renovations will not proceed with unapproved structural work, ensuring total price predictability without arbitrary surprise add-ons.
 7 
 State Licensing, Insurance & Building Compliance
 Section 7.0 
 7.1 Arkansas Contractor License: All-Star Renovations operates as a licensed Arkansas contractor.
 7.2 Insurance Protections: For homeowner peace of mind, the Company maintains full in comprehensive commercial general liability insurance coverage and carries statutory Worker’s Compensation Insurance covering all on-site personnel and install craftsmen. Certificates of Insurance (COI) are provided upon request.
 7.3 Code Compliance & Permits: All plumbing relocations, shower pan slope gradients, shower valve anti-scald pressure balancing mechanisms, and electrical GFCI hookups conform strictly to the Arkansas State Plumbing Code, Arkansas Fire Prevention Code, and Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) safety recommendations. Where municipal permits are legally mandated by the City of Conway or adjacent Central Arkansas municipalities, All-Star Renovations pulls all required master permits.
 8 
 Cancellation, 3-Day Right of Rescission & Refunds
 Section 8.0 
 notification_important 
 Arkansas Statutory Notice of Cancellation (3-Day Rescission) 
 Under Arkansas Code Title 4 (Trade and Commerce) and federal FTC Door-to-Door Sales regulations, homeowners who execute a residential remodeling contract signed at their home possess the legal right to cancel the agreement without penalty prior to midnight of the third (3rd) business day following contract execution.
 8.1 Exercising Cancellation: To effectively exercise your statutory right of rescission, homeowner must send written notice via certified mail or via electronic timestamped notice to legal@allstarreno.com prior to the conclusion of the three-day window. Upon receipt, all initial earnest deposits are returned in full within ten (10) business days.
 8.2 Cancellations Beyond Rescission Window: Following the expiration of the statutory 3-day rescission period, materials enter custom manufacturing and logistics procurement. In the event of customer cancellation after day 3 but prior to on-site demolition, homeowner shall be liable for non-refundable custom fabrication charges, custom glass cutting, supplier restocking fees (typically 20%), and incurred direct engineering costs.
 9 
 Dispute Resolution & Governing Law (Faulkner County)
 Section 9.0 
 9.1 Governing Jurisdiction: These Terms and Conditions, alongside any supplemental Work Authorization Agreements, shall be governed, interpreted, and construed exclusively in accordance with the substantive laws of the State of Arkansas , without regard to conflict of law principles.
 9.2 Exclusive Legal Venue: Any legal action, proceeding, arbitration, or judicial claim arising from or relating to our remodeling operations, billing disputes, or warranty interpretations shall be filed and litigated exclusively within the Circuit Court of Faulkner County, Arkansas .
 9.3 Good Faith Mediation: Prior to initiating formal court litigation, the parties agree to make a good-faith effort to resolve any construction, material, or payment disagreement through an informal conciliation conference conducted on-site or mediated through an agreed neutral construction arbitrator in Faulkner County.
 10 
 Contact & Official Inquiries
 Section 10.0 
 For formal legal notices, warranty claims processing, Change Order records, or inquiries regarding these Terms and Conditions, please address your correspondence to our primary Conway headquarters:
